answer: A crude, flat 2D cartoon meme sticker of a chubby cat laughing hysterically. The cat is a round, egg-shaped yellow blob with bright banana-yellow fur and a slightly paler cream oval on its belly, almost no neck, two small triangular ears on top of its head, a tiny dot nose, three thin whiskers on each cheek, short stubby arms and legs, and a short little tail. A few comic teardrops fly out from the corners of its eyes. The cat tilts its head back and leans backward, one tiny paw clutching its belly and the other paw pointing straight at the viewer as if mocking them, with small motion lines around the body to show it shaking with laughter. Thick, slightly uneven black outlines, flat solid colors with no shading or gradients, intentionally simple and goofy like a hand-drawn doodle. Centered on a plain pure white background, square 1:1 composition, no text, no watermark, no background details.
